what: Proposed commit-content forbidden check uses exact-path awk only
scenario_or_breakage: Paths under a forbidden submodule root (e.g. vendor/foo/bar when vendor/foo is listed) are not flagged; commit is accepted and may be pushed
suggested_fix: post_dispatch_forbidden_revert already uses prefix matching; reuse that logic (extract a shared matcher) for baseline..HEAD paths instead of the plan's exact-match awk
